LogEntries.Entry: Someone at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> wants a package carried to the <Alias=FinalLocation>. The posting says personal.
The sender wants a present carried to a woman at the <Alias=FinalLocation>. He would take it himself, but he has tried that twice. I need to collect it from by the crates and take it to her.
I've got the Goods Package. It goes to <Alias=FinalLocation> on <Alias=targetPlanet>, whenever I'm heading that way.
A man at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> asked me to carry a present to a woman at the <Alias=FinalLocation>. It was real coffee. She's going over to see him herself.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the sender at the <Alias=DungeonLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're here for the package? Quickly, before I change my mind.
I'll take the package.
It's by the crates. Don't shake it. And don't tell her it's from me. Actually, no. Tell her. She'll know anyway.
Just tell her yourself. Worst she says is thanks.
That's not the worst she could say, and you know it. Take the box. I'll be braver next time.
Why not take it yourself?
Because I'd get there, talk about the weather and come home with it still in my hand. I've done that twice.
Is it fragile?
Only to me. It's real coffee. Not the stuff we usually get. She said once she missed it. I don't think she knows I heard.
Why are you nervous?
Because it's for her.
Is it you? It's you. Good.
Can I help you?
That's got a ribbon on it. Nobody ties ribbons. Is that for me?
It's for you. A present.
Real coffee. I said that once, on a bad day, months ago. Don't tell him anything. I'll go over myself.
That smell's coming through the paper.
It's coffee. Real coffee. Oh, that idiot. That lovely idiot.
Do you know who it's from?
There's one person who'd ask a stranger to carry this instead of walking it over. So yes.
Were you expecting it?
No. Hoping, a bit. You don't say that out loud.
I need something carried to someone who isn't far away, and I'd rather it wasn't me.
